title: E-safety & Cyberbullying
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 1 Week 5 Study sheet pp.25-26, Classwork, Homework

scenes.t: E-safety means staying safe and secure when we use the internet.
Cyberbullying is using the internet, apps or online games to hurt, embarrass, threaten or bother someone, again and again.
If someone is mean to you online, first take evidence. Save screenshots of the messages, so you have proof.
Tell a trusted adult, like a parent or a teacher, about what is happening.
Do not be mean back. Saying hurtful things in return does not help.
Use the block button, or unfriend the person, so they cannot contact you again.
You can also report the account inside the app, so the website knows about it.
Never keep it a secret. If a friend tells you they are being bullied, help them tell an adult.

items.a: Staying safe and secure when using the internet.
Using the internet to hurt or bother someone again and again.
Screenshots or records of the mean messages, to show as proof.
Stopping a person from contacting you.
Telling the app or website about a bad account.
A parent or teacher you can talk to.

items.q: Which is an example of cyberbullying?
o: Sending threatening or mean messages in a chat

items.q: What is the first thing to do if you face cyberbullying?
To keep evidence of cyberbullying, you should...
o: Forward the messages to all your friends

items.q: Someone bullies you in an online game. What should you do first?
o: Stop, do not reply, and block them

items.q: Which is NOT a correct solution for cyberbullying?
o: Keeping it a secret and feeling sad
